name_note: The species was first described as Bacteroides massiliensis with type strain B84634, the strain GTDB uses as representative; later work uses the name Phocaeicola massiliensis.

sentences.text: The species was described from Gram-negative anaerobic rods isolated from a blood culture of a healthy baby born at term, and named Bacteroides massiliensis.
It was characterised as a bile-resistant anaerobic species whose type strain is B84634, sharing 92.8 percent 16S rRNA similarity with Bacteroides vulgatus.
In tumour tissues from North Indian colorectal cancer patients profiled by 16S rRNA sequencing, Bacteroides massiliensis was among four species detected only in cancer tissue.
Choline-to-trimethylamine converting bacteria including Phocaeicola massiliensis were reported as enriched in men with abnormal semen parameters.
